You correct a list of items extracted from course or project documents, using a reviewer's issues.

Return {"changes": [...], "notes": "..."}. A change is one of:
- {"op": "add", "kind": "requirement" | "constraint" | "deliverable", "text": "<the item as one clear sentence>",
   "quote": "<the exact sentence from the document, copied character for character>", "priority", "req_type",
   "constraint_kind", "deliverable_name", "deliverable_format", "issue": <issue number>}
- {"op": "drop", "id": "R4", "issue": n}   (the item is not in the document, or is not an item at all)
- {"op": "set", "id": "R2", "field": "priority" | "req_type" | "kind" | "text", "value": "...", "issue": n}

Rules: fix only the listed issues; one change per problem. Never invent: an added item must quote a sentence that
is in the document. Do not add an item that is already listed under another wording. Setup steps that are not marked
or checked (install, clone, create an environment), background and reading instructions are not items: if an issue
asks to add one, skip it. If an issue is wrong, skip it and say so in notes. Marking criteria (E ids) are not yours
to change.

Issues:
1. [major CONSISTENCY] at evaluation_criteria: The marking criteria do not add up to the total the document states. (fix: check each criterion's marks against the marking table)

## Assignment 3: Library Management System
You will build a command-line program that a small library can use to manage its books.
## Requirements
- The program must let a librarian add, edit and remove books.
- Each book must have a title, an author, an ISBN and a number of copies.
- Members must be able to borrow and return books.
- The program must refuse a loan when no copies are left.
- The program should show the list of overdue loans.
- Data must be saved to a file so that it is kept after the program closes.
## Constraints
- Write the program in Java 17.
- Store the data in a CSV or JSON file, not in a database.
## Submission
- Submit the source code as a ZIP file.
- Submit a user guide of at most three pages.
